requirement: Evidence must have exactly the fields `requirement` (string), `inputs` (nonempty array), and `justification` (string); each input must have exactly `path` (string), `line_start` and `line_end` (positive integers), and `contents` (string).
justification: Scenarios: missing/extra top-level and input fields; wrong and null field types; empty input list; zero, negative, fractional and excessive line bounds. Serde strict structs enforce types and keys, validate requires an input, and lines enforces positive ordered ranges. Tests reject these malformed attestations. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
